preconditions.description: The input verb must be a string.
The input verb must end with one of the infinitive suffixes: 'ar', 'er', or 'ir'.

postconditions.description: The output must be a dictionary.
The output dictionary must contain exactly one key, which is the original verb.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value[verb]) == 6 and all(isinstance(conjugation, str) for conjugation in return_value[verb])
postconditions.description: The value associated with the verb must be a list of six strings representing the conjugations.
